# Setup API endpoint
{: .no_toc}

A physical rig, maze or apparatus in the lab, with the equipment installed in it.

## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## Endpoints

- **Private portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/personal_attributes/setup/` (needs a token; one record: append `<id>/`)
- **Public portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/public/personal_attributes/setup/` (read-only, public projects, no token)
- **Response keys:** `setup` (detail, create, update), `setups` (list)
- **Permissions:** object permissions on the record itself (member / manager / owner roles)
- **Deleting:** also deletes the linked [`setupgroupmembershipinvitation`](/api/personal_attributes/setupgroupmembershipinvitation/), [`setupmembershipinvitation`](/api/personal_attributes/setupmembershipinvitation/) records; refused (400) while [`behavior`](/api/modules/behavior/), [`equipment`](/api/modules/equipment/) records point to it

Form-only inputs (sent on create or update, not returned in responses):

- `setup_type_category` **[required]**. Choices: `I`, `E`, `A`, `HA`, `RA`, `FA`, `U`.

## Fields

**[required]** fields must be sent on create; **[read-only]** fields are returned but cannot be set. A *nestable* relation can be traversed in filters (`filter{field.other}`) and sideloaded with `include[]=field.*`; other relations can only be compared with ids (`filter{field}=<id>`). See the [query syntax](/api/#query-parameters).

| Field | Description |
|:------|:------------|
| `id` | UUID string **[read-only]** |
| `name` | string **[required]**; max 50 characters |
| `location` | string; max 100 characters; nullable. Location of the setup, e.g., "Room 302B, Neuroscience Building" or "Room 201, Surgery room". |
| `description` | string; nullable |
| `setup_type` | [`setuptype`](/api/taxonomies/setuptype/) id **[required]**; nullable |
| `specifications` | JSON object; nullable. The specifications of the setup, e.g., dimensions, weight, power requirements, etc. |
| `is_public` | boolean. Designates if the setup is publicly available |
| `image` | string; max 100 characters |
| `users` | computed **[read-only]** |
| `groups` | computed **[read-only]** |

## List
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/personal_attributes/setup/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `401` Not authenticated; `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('setup', load_all=True)
records = resp['setups']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
resp = client.load('setup', 'load_all', true);
records = resp.setups;
```

### Response example
{: .no_toc}

```json
{
    "setups": [
        {
            "id": "<id>",
            "name": "Setup 1",
            "location": "",
            "description": "",
            "setup_type": "<setuptype-id>",
            "specifications": {},
            "is_public": true,
            "image": "",
            "users": null,
            "groups": null
        }
    ],
    "meta": {
        "page": 1,
        "per_page": 100,
        "total_results": 1,
        "total_pages": 1
    }
}
```

## Add
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** POST
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/personal_attributes/setup/`
- **Data:** JSON object with at least the required fields
- **Responses:** `201` Created; `400` Bad request (validation errors per field); `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('setup', data={"name": "Setup 1", "setup_type": "<setuptype-id>", "setup_type_category": "I"})
record = resp.json()['setup']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
created = client.save(struct('name', 'Setup 1', 'setup_type', '<setuptype-id>', 'setup_type_category', 'I'), 'setup');
record = created.setup;
```

## Detail
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/personal_attributes/setup/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('setup', id='<id>')
record = resp.json()['setup']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
out = client.load('setup', 'id', '<id>');
record = out.setup;
```

### Response example
{: .no_toc}

```json
{
    "setup": {
        "id": "<id>",
        "name": "Setup 1",
        "location": "",
        "description": "",
        "setup_type": "<setuptype-id>",
        "specifications": {},
        "is_public": true,
        "image": "",
        "users": null,
        "groups": null
    }
}
```

## Change
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** PATCH
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/personal_attributes/setup/<id>/`
- **Data:** JSON object with the fields to change. Lists (`projects`, `tags`, ...) and JSON payloads (`details`, coordinates) are replaced as a whole: read the record first and send the full list or object.
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `400` Bad request; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('setup', id='<id>', data={"name": "Setup 1 (renamed)"})
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.save(struct('id', '<id>', 'name', 'Setup 1 (renamed)'), 'setup', 'method', 'patch');
```

## Delete
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** DELETE
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/personal_attributes/setup/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `204` Deleted; `400` Still referenced by other records; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.delete('setup', id='<id>')
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.delete('<id>', 'setup');
```

## JSON field schemas

Schema for the specifications of a setup. The REST API returns these JSON fields as stored and validates writes against the schemas below. Every version is published at `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/Setup/<Type>/<version>.json` and never changes; see [Public schemas](/api/public-schemas/).

### Specifications

- type code `specifications` · version 1.0.0 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/Setup/specifications/1.0.0.json)

Specifications you want to add to your setup. Saved as key-value pairs. Values can be strings or numbers.

| Property | Description |
|:---------|:------------|
| `key` | text |
| `value` | object |

Illustrative payload:

```json
[
    {
        "key": "text",
        "value": {}
    }
]
```


## Data model

The fields are described for the web forms on the [Setup data model page](/datamodel/personal_attributes/setup/).
